why_an_addendum: The parent seal says the exposure audit CANNOT tell whether an exposed finding survives recompute. For pvc-11 that turns out to be answerable tonight: I have repaired rep_med for all 1,159 cells (R-176) and per-unit f1_f0_pref in data/phase22a_results/h1_functional.parquet, joinable on (recording, unit_idx). Going beyond the parent's stated scope requires its own registration.

the_banked_claim_under_test.statement: F1/F0 correlates with rep_med in OPPOSITE directions across substrates: pvc-11 +0.388 (p = 6e-9), Allen meta-fixed -0.183 (all 12 sessions negative).
the_banked_claim_under_test.status_in_EPISTEMIC_STATE: Locked findings with multiple disciplines verified
the_banked_claim_under_test.disciplines_it_cleared: full-sequence surrogate, rate-matched (3 methods), rate-stratified within-cell on both substrates, cross-substrate, phylogenetic-conservation deflation, cross-engine direction match

why_it_is_exposed_and_how_badly.axis: rep_med IS the clipped repulsion integral -- the finding names it.
why_it_is_exposed_and_how_badly.measured_this_session: On pvc-11: 918/1159 values (79.2%) sit EXACTLY on the lower rail at 0.0; the median is exactly 0.0000; ALL 1,159 changed under repair; the true signed median is -0.7015; 239 cells had the SIGN INVERTED.
why_it_is_exposed_and_how_badly.the_sharp_problem: A Spearman correlation against a variable that is EXACTLY CONSTANT for 79.2% of the sample is carried entirely by the ~20.8% minority that escaped the rail. Ties are handled by mid-ranking, so the railed cells contribute a single tied rank block and no gradient. The banked +0.388 is therefore a statement about a fifth of the data, whether or not that was understood at the time.

the_test: Spearman(f1_f0_pref, rep_med) on the DEPLOYED clipped axis -- which must reproduce the banked +0.388 or the join is wrong -- and then on the REPAIRED signed axis, on exactly the same cells. Reproduction of the deployed value is the gate; without it nothing else is read.

R0_JOIN_INVALID.fires_if: the deployed-axis correlation does not reproduce the banked pvc-11 value to within +/-0.05, or fewer than 300 cells join
R0_JOIN_INVALID.means: VOID. The join or the cell set is wrong; report as void and do not interpret R1-R3.

R1_SURVIVES.fires_if: signed-axis rho has the SAME SIGN, |rho| >= 0.15, and p < 0.01
R1_SURVIVES.means: The finding stands and is now better supported than when banked -- it was measured on a mostly-constant variable and survives on a real one.

R2_WEAKENED.means: DOWNGRADE from locked. The direction is not contradicted but the evidence is much thinner than +0.388 suggested.

R3_REVERSED.fires_if: signed-axis rho has the OPPOSITE sign with p < 0.05
R3_REVERSED.means: SERIOUS. The entire finding is a claim about the SIGN of the pvc-11 arm relative to Allen. If pvc-11's sign flips on the repaired axis, the substrate-systematic sign-flip -- the whole content of the finding -- is unsupported and may be an artifact of the clip. Report at full prominence; this is the outcome I would least like to write.
R3_REVERSED.required_follow_up: Do NOT conclude the finding is refuted from the pvc-11 arm alone. Allen's arm rests on a different dataset whose rep_med has not been recomputed; a one-armed reversal makes the claim UNSUPPORTED, not false.

stated_in_advance_so_it_cannot_become_an: Whatever the outcome, the banked +0.388 was computed against a variable that is exactly constant on 79.2% of the sample. That fact alone downgrades the QUALITY of the original evidence regardless of what the repaired axis shows, and it must appear in the write-up even under R1.
